newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific, Target waiting period expires.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific, Target waiting period expires.

text.p: Boston Scientific Corp and Target Therapeutics Inc said the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act relating to their announced merger expired on February 27, without any request for additional information from the U.S. Department of Justice or the Federal Trade Commission.
The company said the expiration of the waiting period eliminates any regulatory obstacle to closing the merger.
The merger is subject to the satisfaction of other conditions, including that the shareholders of Target approve the merger.
A special meeting of the stockholders of Target to approve the transaction is scheduled for April 8.
